items.description: Create the shared Desktop Protocol package with Valibot-validated command, response, event, snapshot, and error envelopes.
steps: Create a workspace package for the Desktop Protocol.
Define protocol versioning, request/response correlation, command envelopes, event envelopes, snapshot envelopes, and structured errors.
Add Valibot runtime validation tests that reject malformed privileged messages and accept representative valid messages.
Run the package tests plus the required verification gates.
items.regression_notes: Committed in d6c02a9 (feat(protocol): add @pi-gui/desktop-protocol with Valibot schemas and auth handshake). Contains typed command/event/snapshot/error envelopes, parseClientCommand/parseServerEnvelope/parseEventPayload helpers, 17/17 tests. Fixed missing workspace dep in desktop-core and noUncheckedIndexedAccess lint in commit-push-service.ts to satisfy root typecheck gate.

items.description: Add a Sidecar runtime compatibility probe that decides whether Bun can run the pi runtime stack or whether the plan must switch to bundled Node.
steps: Create the Sidecar package or runtime test harness.
Probe imports for `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`, `@pi-gui/pi-sdk-driver`, filesystem catalog persistence, and child process spawning under Bun.
Record a deterministic Node fallback path when a clear Bun incompatibility is observed.
Run the probe and the required verification gates without interactive prompts.

items.description: Extract a headless Desktop Core seam from the current Electron store for workspace, session, composer, model, and persistence behavior.
steps: Create a shared Desktop Core package with explicit platform adapter interfaces.
Move or wrap the minimum state orchestration needed for workspace listing/sync, session create/select/archive, composer send/cancel, model selection, and JSON persistence.
Keep Electron Desktop callers working through adapters or compatibility wrappers.
Run focused core tests or existing Electron tests that cover the touched behavior plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Implement the Sidecar authenticated WebSocket service around Desktop Core.
steps: Start a localhost-only WebSocket service that accepts the Desktop Protocol envelopes.
Require a per-run token and reject missing, invalid, or wrong-origin clients.
Expose commands for fresh snapshot, workspace list/sync, session create/select/archive, composer send/cancel, model refresh/selection, and shutdown.
Emit typed state, runtime, and error events to connected clients.
Run Sidecar integration tests plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Support Sidecar reconnect semantics with fresh snapshots and live in-flight session continuity.
steps: Add client reconnect handling that authenticates again and requests a fresh snapshot.
Keep in-flight Sidecar sessions alive across Desktop Client reloads.
Resubscribe selected session transcript/runtime streams after reconnect.
Prove reconnect behavior with an automated Sidecar integration test and the required verification gates.

items.description: Create the Svelte Desktop app shell using SvelteKit static output inside Tauri.
steps: Create `apps/svelte-desktop` as a workspace app with SvelteKit static output and Tauri configuration.
Add root scripts or package scripts for typecheck, lint, development launch, and bounded desktop smoke execution.
Ensure production build does not require a SvelteKit SSR server.
Run the Svelte app build/typecheck plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Make Tauri supervise the local Sidecar process and hand the Desktop Client its connection data safely.
steps: On app launch, mint a random token and start the Sidecar as a supervised child process with port, token, and environment.
Expose only the connection data needed by the Svelte Desktop Client through a Tauri command.
Show a user-visible error when the Sidecar fails or crashes instead of silently hanging.
Terminate the Sidecar on full app quit without killing it on frontend reload.
Run a bounded Tauri lifecycle smoke test plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Implement the Svelte `desktopClient` store that owns connection lifecycle, state projection, command status, and event reduction.
steps: Connect to the Sidecar with the Tauri-provided token and WebSocket URL.
Load an initial full snapshot and apply typed events into a projected app state.
Expose derived state for workspace, selected session, timeline, composer status, model settings, connection state, and known gaps.
Handle reconnect and snapshot resync without duplicating canonical state ownership in the client.
Run store tests or component-level integration tests plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Build the Svelte Tracer Bullet UI for workspace and session workflows.
steps: Render the Desktop App shell with workspace menu, session list, selected session, timeline, composer, and settings/model affordances needed for the Tracer Bullet.
Support adding/selecting a workspace, creating/selecting/archiving a session, sending a message, canceling a run, and selecting model/thinking settings.
Render live timeline streaming from Sidecar events.
Show clear known-gap labels or hidden controls for terminal, extension UI, worktree create/remove, and commit/push.
Run Svelte UI tests or desktop smoke tests plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Preserve JSON catalog/session persistence across Svelte Desktop app restart.
steps: Use the existing JSON catalog/session persistence path through Desktop Core or compatible adapters.
Create a workspace and session in the Svelte Desktop, quit or restart the app, and verify the same workspace/session state is restored.
Ensure no migration to SQLite or Tauri key-value storage is introduced for this milestone.
Run persistence tests plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Add the Svelte/Tauri Playwright desktop core smoke lane.
steps: Add Playwright helpers that launch the real Svelte Desktop Tauri surface with controlled Sidecar fixtures or test runtime configuration.
Cover launch/reopen, workspace menu, session create/select/archive, composer send/cancel, timeline streaming, model selection, and persistence.
Make the lane bounded and non-interactive on macOS.
Run the new smoke lane plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Add a local macOS packaged `.app` smoke path for the Svelte Desktop.
steps: Add package scripts that build a local unsigned macOS `.app` for development smoke only.
Verify the packaged app launches the Sidecar, completes token handshake, opens the Desktop Client, restores persisted state, and cleans up the Sidecar on quit.
Do not require signing, notarization, keychain access, admin prompts, or Apple credentials.
Run the package smoke command plus the required verification gates.

items.description: Document canonical promotion status, known gaps, and follow-up issue seeds for post-Tracer parity work.
steps: Add developer/user-facing documentation that explains when the Svelte Desktop is eligible to become the Canonical App.
List explicit known gaps for terminal UI, extension UI rendering, worktree create/remove, commit/push, signed releases, Linux, Windows, and auto-update.
Ensure missing features are not exposed as half-working controls in the Svelte UI.
Run documentation-adjacent checks and the required verification gates.
